summary: Since 2011 have never used LMS. It was the same workflow->class website, class feed, individual blogs and website. Students wanted all their stuff across all classes in one place, didn't want to worry about digital identity, just content #digped
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Since 2011 have never used LMS. It was the same workflow->class website, class feed, individual blogs and website. Students wanted all their stuff across all classes in one place, didn't want to worry about digital identity, just content #digped
